```{r}
library(tidyverse)
setwd("/Users/magalhae/Desktop/FANCY_DNAcaller/FANCI_DNAseq_T2T_CHM3/NPKL_SAD_genes/counts")
```
```{r}
df <- read_csv("Ranking_SADs.csv")
```
```{r}
data_no_symbol <- df %>%
  filter(is.na(gene_symbol) | gene_symbol == "")
```
```{r}
# 3. Separate and process rows with a gene_symbol
data_with_symbol_processed <- df %>%
  # Keep only rows that have a gene symbol
  filter(!is.na(gene_symbol) & gene_symbol != "") %>%
  # Group by the gene symbol to perform calculations on each gene
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  # Create a new column with the sum of TPM for the entire group
  #mutate(TPM_sum = sum(TPM)) %>%
  # Within each group, keep only the single row with the highest original TPM
  slice_max(order_by = TPM, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  # Replace the original TPM with the summed TPM
  # mutate(TPM = TPM_sum) %>%
  # Remove the temporary helper column
  # select(-TPM_sum) %>%
  # Ungroup to finish
  ungroup()
final_df <- bind_rows(data_with_symbol_processed, data_no_symbol)
```

```{r}
final_df$Log2TPM = log2(final_df$TPM+1)
final_df <- final_df %>%
  arrange(desc(TPM)) %>%
  mutate(Ranking = row_number())
final_df <- final_df %>%
  arrange(desc(Cov_MAX_DNA)) %>%
  mutate(DNA_covRanking = row_number())
```

```{r}
write_csv(final_df, "final_df.csv")
```


```{r}
df2 <- filter(final_df, NumReads > 0 )
df2 <- filter(df2, !gene_biotype == 'scRNA' )
df2 <- filter(df2, !gene_biotype == 'scaRNA' )
df2 <- filter(df2, !gene_biotype == 'miRNA' )
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=12}
graph <- ggplot(df2, aes(y = DNA_covRanking, x = Ranking, colour = Type)) +
  #geom_hdr() +
  geom_point() +
  # facet_grid( . ~ gene_biotype, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
graph
```

```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
ggplot(df2, aes(x = gene_biotype, y = Log2TPM, fill = Type)) +
  introdataviz::geom_split_violin(alpha = .4, trim = FALSE,scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = .2, alpha = .6, fatten = NULL, show.legend = FALSE, outliers = T) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = "mean_se", geom = "pointrange", show.legend = F, 
               position = position_dodge(.175)) +
  facet_grid(gene_biotype ~ ., scales = "free" ) +
  # scale_x_discrete(name = "Condition", labels = c("Non-word", "Word")) +
  # scale_y_continuous(name = "Reaction time (ms)",
  #                    breaks = seq(200, 800, 100), 
  #                    limits = c(200, 800)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Gene type") +
  theme_minimal()
```
